text:
[excited] Eight grand a year on club soccer. [pause][whispers] Why?

Ask any club-soccer parent… and the real answer never comes out.

[pause] Here’s the psychologist Alfred add-ler, writing in nineteen twenty-seven. Nobody calls it vanity. They call it ambition. Investing in her future.

But here’s what that story quietly costs.

In a twenty-nineteen study, Post and colleagues tracked the real bill. Thousands a year… chasing a scholarship most kids never get.

So why can’t you say why? [pause][sighs] Because that’s what vanity sounds like from the inside. It was never dishonesty. And naming it… makes it optional again.

[pause] Eight grand a year. Now you can say why.
